ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the reason code. When it matches a stored reason code, that reason code is updated. Otherwise a new reason code is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique reason code name shown to agents and supervisors.

AppliesTo.description: Presence state an agent enters when they select this reason code.

SortOrder.description: Relative order the reason code is listed in, lowest first.

Enabled.description: Whether the reason code can be selected by agents.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the reason code, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ReasonCodes.description: The agent state reason codes to create or update.
